sounds good

sunday 2025-12-14, 2-hour outdoor session, madison community garden, early-afternoon window, and weather is the big constraint – got it

a couple things so you can pin this down cleanly on your calendar:

1) time choice within your window  
given the 1–3 pm range and winter light in mid-december, i’d lock:
- start: 1:00 pm  
- end: 3:00 pm  

that gives you:
- warmest part of the day  
- max daylight in case it’s overcast or snow on the ground  
- a bit of buffer for setup at 12:30 and teardown until ~3:30

2) recommended event title & description text (you can paste this into your calendar)

title:  
- Composting Workshop – Community Garden, Madison

time/date:  
- sunday, december 14, 2025  
- 1:00–3:00 pm  
- organizer: brian kowalczyk (brian.kowalczyk@example.com, (928) 555-7293)

location:  
- community garden, madison (outdoor, no indoor backup)

description (draft):  
- Outdoor, hands-on composting workshop focused on beginner-friendly, low-maintenance compost systems suitable for home gardens and small community plots.  
- Audience: beginners and folks who know the basics but haven’t started composting yet.  
- Group size: 15–25 participants.  

agenda (you can keep or tweak):  
- 1:00–1:10 – welcome, quick intro, safety and “what we’ll do”  
- 1:10–1:30 – compost basics: greens vs. browns, moisture, aeration, what to add / avoid  
- 1:30–1:55 – systems overview: simple backyard piles, bins, tumblers, community-garden setups  
- 1:55–2:25 – hands-on: building or turning a pile, checking moisture, particle size, layering demo  
- 2:25–2:45 – troubleshooting: smelly piles, rodents, winter composting, common mistakes  
- 2:45–3:00 – Q&A, how to start at home, local resources

materials checklist (for your own notes in the event):  
- one active pile or bin on site to demo  
- a couple of pitchforks/shovels + gloves  
- sample “greens” (veggie scraps, coffee grounds) and “browns” (leaves, shredded cardboard)  
- 1–2 simple printed handouts or a QR link to a one-pager  
- small whiteboard or big notepad for ratios & do/don’t lists

3) weather planning (since that’s your main concern)  
for this date i’d build in:

- a “weather decision” note in the calendar description:  
  - “Weather call: decide by 10:00 am same day based on temperature, wind, and precipitation. If cancelled or postponed, notify by email and posted sign at garden gate.”

- a backup range you’re comfortable with (just for your own planning):  
  - acceptable conditions: no heavy rain/snow, wind < ~20 mph, temp above whatever minimum you’re ok with (e.g., 30–35°F+ if people are dressed for it)

if you’re ok with:
- date: sunday dec 14, 2025  
- time: 1:00–3:00 pm  

confirm that’s the exact slot you want, and i’ll treat that as the final scheduled time for your “Composting Workshop – Community Garden, Madison.”
